content.text: Theo's 5 months, so he's a bit early. Health Canada's guidance is to start around 6 months, when he can sit with support, hold his head steady and show interest in your food. Until then, milk is all he needs. In the meantime, let him watch you eat and give him tummy time and sitting practice. Start iron-rich foods first, like meat, tofu or iron-fortified cereal. It's worth confirming timing with your provider or public health.
